cands.bio: Republican member of the Alabama House of Representatives for District 15 since November 2022. Business owner (CrossFit Alabaster, Henley Developments, LLC). Longtime Helena City Council member. Lost her 2026 re-election bid to Nell Brown (D).
cands.gaps: We could not find her birthplace or when she may have moved within Alabama. We found no stated positions from her on data centers, homestead property taxes, foreign or investor land buying, growth and land conservation, immigration or H-1B, school choice or teacher pay. The stated positions we did find come from a 2021 survey for a different district's special election, and she did not complete Ballotpedia's 2022 or 2026 surveys. We found no documented controversies, endorsements for 2026, or foreign ties. Her sponsored-legislation list on Ballotpedia did not load, so we could not review the bills she sponsored or other actions in office.

cands.name: Nell Brown

money.note: Covers January 2023 on, primary and general. Party-committee lines are often in-kind staff and mail.

cands.bio: Democrat from McCalla, Jefferson County. Legal assistant by profession, with a bachelor's degree from Miles College (2009) and a Juris Doctor in progress at Miles Law School. Former Jefferson County Democratic Committee member and school volunteer for over 16 years. Ballotpedia lists her as winning House District 15 in 2026.

endorsements.text: Listed on voter-guide recommendations from Tabitha's List, The Neighborhood Guy's Candidates Jamboree, and Unburdening The Ballot (Sway voting groups).

cands.gaps: We could not find where Nell Brown was born or raised, or when she moved to McCalla. We found no statements or actions from her on data centers, homestead property taxes, land buying by out-of-state or foreign owners, growth and land protection, immigration or H-1B, policing, gun laws, or abortion. Her position on school vouchers and charters is also unstated. She has no record in elected office, so there are no bills or actions to report. Her 2024 Jefferson County school board bid is listed only as withdrawn or disqualified, with no further detail.
